## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`): I certify the
      [Developer Certificate of Origin 1.1](https://developercertificate.org/) for this
      contribution, which is licensed under Apache-2.0
      (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/xinp-hub/pydiggs/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md)).
- [ ] Tests cover the change, and `uv run pytest` passes.
- [ ] `uv run ruff check .`, `uv run ruff format --check .` and `uv run mypy` pass.
- [ ] Docs and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated if users will notice the change.
